newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 13.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- United Kingdom refuses to abide by European labour regulations.
-- Lyonnaise des Eaux and Generale des Eaux to compete for water supply markets in the Asia-Pacific area.
-- New group created by merger of Axa and UAP will have to prove that increased size triggers higher efficiency. The group will be world's number one fund manager.
-- State sells a 10 percent stake in oil group Elf Aquitaine ELFP.Pa held through state holding Erap.

-- Renault and PSA carmakers seek government's approval to reshuffle workforce, cut up to 40,000 jobs through early retirement and hire some 14,000 younger workers, in drive to improve competitiveness.
